mapper.select: WITH authorization_facts AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM t_user user_state WHERE user_state.id = #{userId} AND user_state.status = 1 AND user_state.deleted_at IS NULL ) AS user_enabled, EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM t_user_role user_role JOIN t_role_permission role_permission ON role_permission.role_id = user_role.role_id JOIN t_permission permission ON permission.id = role_permission.permission_id WHERE user_role.user_id = #{userId} AND permission.code = 'link:create' ) AS action_allowed, EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM t_short_domain short_domain_state WHERE short_domain_state.id = #{shortDomainId} AND short_domain_state.status = 1 ) AS short_domain_enabled, () AS short_domain_granted ) SELECT user_enabled, action_allowed, short_domain_enabled, short_domain_granted FROM authorization_facts

WITH management_facts AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM t_user actor WHERE actor.id = #{userId} AND actor.status = 1 AND actor.deleted_at IS NULL ) AS user_enabled, EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM t_short_domain short_domain_state WHERE short_domain_state.id = #{shortDomainId} AND short_domain_state.status = 1 ) AS short_domain_enabled, EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM t_user_role user_role JOIN t_role_permission role_permission ON role_permission.role_id = user_role.role_id JOIN t_permission permission ON permission.id = role_permission.permission_id WHERE user_role.user_id = #{userId} AND permission.code = 'link:manage:any' ) AS global_management_allowed, ( #{userId} = #{createdByUserId} AND EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM t_user_role user_role JOIN t_role_permission role_permission ON role_permission.role_id = user_role.role_id JOIN t_permission permission ON permission.id = role_permission.permission_id WHERE user_role.user_id = #{userId} AND permission.code = #{actionPermission} ) AND () ) AS own_management_allowed ) SELECT user_enabled, short_domain_enabled, global_management_allowed, own_management_allowed FROM management_facts
